name: FFS_ACTIVITY_MOVE_LOG
description: Stores a history of move, reschedule and reorder operations for activities.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the log record.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Activity identifier of the moved activity.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a parent action_log record.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Time of the action in GMT format.

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when this operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Group of screens or a module the corresponding action has been invoked from.

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Reference to user who performed move operation to ffs_user.user_id.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to user agent identifier .

columns.name: SORTING_ORDER
columns.description: Order of operation within the same batch.

columns.name: FROM_ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the origin route the activity was moved from.

columns.name: FROM_PREVIOUS_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Position of the moved activity in the origin route.

columns.name: TO_ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the destination route the activity was moved to.

columns.name: TO_PREVIOUS_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Position of the moved activity in the destination route.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Result of the activity move operation.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_MASTER_ID
columns.description: Master ID for multiday activity segment.

columns.name: MOVE_ACTIVITY_COMMAND_TYPE
columns.description: There are commands: MoveAppt = 0, CreateMultidaySegment = 1, DeleteMultidaySegment = 2, ChangeDurationMultidaySegment = 3.

columns.name: FROM_WORK_LENGTH
columns.description: Change activity duration from from_work_length.

columns.name: TO_WORK_LENGTH
columns.description: Change activity duration to to_work_length.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ESTIMATION_METHOD
columns.description: Travel estimation method (after move).

columns.name: PREV_TRAVEL_TIME
columns.description: Travel time in minutes (before move).

columns.name: PREV_TRAVEL_ESTIMATION_METHOD
columns.description: Travel estimation method (before move).

columns.name: MOVE_REASON_ID
columns.description: Reference to move reason type .

columns.name: AUTOROUTED
columns.description: Contains value of AUTO_ROUTED_TO_DATE from APPT table at the moment of move action.

columns.name: VIOLATIONS
columns.description: Contain move action violations: APPT_WARNING_WORKZONE_MISMATCH (1 << 12) /* Move action: The destination provider has no an appropriate work zone for this appointment */ APPT_WARNING_WORKSKILL_MISMATCH (1 << 13) /* Move action: The destination provider has no an appropriate skill for this appointment.

columns.name: MOVE_REASON_CONDITION
columns.description: MOVE_REASON_BUCKET_TO_RESOURCE (1 << 0) MOVE_REASON_RESOURCE_TO_RESOURCE (1 << 1) MOVE_REASON_RESOURCE_TO_BUCKET (1 << 2) MOVE_REASON_BUCKET_TO_BUCKET (1 << 3) MOVE_REASON_REORDERING_INSIDE_ROUTE (1 << 4).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
